teaser: You give your agent a memory: sessions it can pause, resume and fork, plus a context window you keep lean before compaction kicks in.
takeaways: A session is the persisted conversation with a session_id (storage); context is what sits in the model window right now (working memory).
resume=session_id continues; fork_session=True branches to a new id, original untouched; continue_conversation=True resumes latest in cwd.
Forking branches the conversation, not files (file checkpointing rolls files back); never sum total_cost_usd across resumed results.
Near the limit the runtime compacts earlier history (PreCompact hook fires); persistent rules go in system prompt/CLAUDE.md, re-injected.
